scope: explicit opt-in; default style and frozen films unchanged
canonicalMascot: locked v1; existing editable puppet geometry
surfaces: matte tactile paper; shared stable material grain; soft down-right edges
captions: 2–3 word coral serif cutouts, short attack and clean replacement; no letter jitter

instructionOverrides.oneActionThenHold: One dominant focal idea, overlapping main action plus 2–4 quieter responses
instructionOverrides.continuousIdleDiscouraged: Selected bounded living motion is part of style; independent phases and amplitudes
instructionOverrides.sparseEffects: Connected physical impact, peel, rattle and placement accents
instructionOverrides.quietEnvironment: Layered physical zones and scale changes; no full-room view requirement
instructionOverrides.restrainedCamera: Purposeful source follow, punch-in and match cuts allowed

motion.livingHold: seeded frame-indexed transforms held 2–4 frames; no runtime randomness
motion.composition: base placement -> main action -> secondary local transform
motion.contact: same composed prop transform drives grip; selected exact-contact jitter coordinated

sound: regenerated exact-script Kokoro; original deterministic synthesized SFX; no unlicensed music
approval: REVIEW_REQUIRED; technical checks do not establish engagement
